\(L_k=\sum_{n=1}^k(n+3)=\frac{k^2+7k}{2}\).

\[
L_{996}=\frac{996^2+7\cdot996}{2}=499,\!494
\]
\[
L_{997}=\frac{997^2+7\cdot997}{2}=500,\!494
\]

So the \(500{,}000\)th listed term is in iteration \(997\), and it is the

\[
500{,}000-499{,}494=506
\]

th listed term of that iteration.

After 996 iterations, the number of processed natural numbers is

\[
996^2+4\cdot996=996,\!000.
\]

Thus iteration 997 starts at \(996{,}001\) and lists 1000 numbers. The 506th listed number is

\[
996{,}001+505=996,\!506.
\]

\[
\boxed{996506}
\]
